title: The precursor discrimination
statement: The corpus sorts its precursor literature by method, not by conclusion: Sendy's coherence program and Biglino's philological procedure are adopted as equipment (the woh-claim-0064 hermeneutic); Sitchin's direction is kept while his apparatus is discarded — the Anunnaki identification stands on the corpus's own comparative grounds (woh-claim-0002) while the Nibiru philology is rejected on the cuneiform record; von Daniken's artifact-accumulation genre is declined as method however large its audience; and the lost-civilization chronologies (Hancock and kin) are handled under the monument-attribution discipline rather than absorbed — agreement with the corpus's conclusions buys no author admission, and rejection by the mainstream buys no author solidarity.

includes: The sorting rule itself: method admits, conclusions do not — the criterion that separates adopted equipment (Sendy, Biglino) from registered neighbors (Sitchin, von Daniken, Hancock)

The Sitchin ruling in both halves: direction kept (the Mesopotamian material matters, the Anunnaki identification stands via woh-claim-0002's own grounds), apparatus discarded (the twelfth-planet philology fails against the cuneiform sources, and the corpus says so)
The von Daniken ruling: the genre he launched is registered as reception history and audience fact, its evidence-accumulation method declined — a mass of weak artifacts is not a strong case
The no-solidarity clause: shared mainstream rejection creates no alliance among the rejected, which is what keeps the corpus from inheriting every precursor's liabilities
excludes: Biographical adjudication of the authors, which the wiki entries carry at documentary grade
The monument and site material, which woh-claim-0058 governs
Wholesale dismissal of the declined authors; registration at their own grade is the posture, not mockery
Any claim that the corpus's method escapes the genre's critics — the method's own record (woh-claim-0064) carries that assessment

source_references.locator: The genre-launching accumulation method the corpus declines, registered at its own scale
The Nibiru-Anunnaki thesis whose direction the corpus keeps and whose apparatus it discards
The cuneiform-sources control on which the Sitchin apparatus is rejected
The lost-civilization chronology handled under the monument-attribution discipline rather than absorbed

alternatives.statement: From outside, the discrimination is invisible: the corpus shares the genre's central move and its mainstream rejection, and sorting precursors by method is genre-internal housekeeping that changes no external assessment.
The cuneiform standard applied to Sitchin, applied with equal force to the corpus's own identifications, would cut against them too; rigor deployed only against neighbors is positioning, not method.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0002 or woh-claim-0064 is revised or retired.
Public prose enlists a declined author's evidence as support, or mocks a declined author beyond registration, both of which this record excludes.
The corpus adopts or drops a precursor's equipment, changing the sorted set.
